response.sql: WITH channel_counts AS (SELECT COALESCE(o.orderbase, 'Missing') AS channel, AVG(e.fillcount) AS avg_filled_quantity, COUNT(*) AS execution_count FROM orderexecutions AS e JOIN orders AS o ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault GROUP BY COALESCE(o.orderbase, 'Missing')) SELECT channel, avg_filled_quantity, execution_count, 1.0 * execution_count / SUM(execution_count) OVER () AS share_of_total FROM channel_counts
